function.return_type: void pointer, represents the starting address of the allocated memory.

function.description: This function is used to deallocate the memory previously allocated by a call to calloc, malloc, or realloc.

parameters.name: p

function.name: rpc_filter
function.description: This function filters exceptions in RPC (Remote Procedure Call) by calling the I_RpcExceptionFilter function with the exception code from the provided EXCEPTION_POINTERS structure.

parameters.name: eptr

function.name: start_rpcss
function.description: This function is used to start the RpcSs service. It opens the service manager, opens the RpcSs service, starts the service, and checks the status of the service until it is running or a timeout occurs.
function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the RpcSs service starts successfully, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: get_rpc_handle
function.description: This function composes a string binding handle and converts it to a binding handle. If successful, it frees the string binding and returns the binding handle.

parameters.name: protseq
parameters.description: This is the protocol sequence.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: This is the network endpoint.

function.return_type: RPC_BINDING_HANDLE, which represents the binding handle for the RPC connection.

function.name: get_irpcss_handle
function.description: This function checks if the irpcss_handle is null. If it is, it creates a new RPC handle using the IRPCSS_PROTSEQ and IRPCSS_ENDPOINT. If another thread has already created the handle, it frees the newly created handle. Finally, it returns the irpcss_handle.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters

function.return_type: RPC_BINDING_HANDLE, which represents the handle to the RPC binding

function.name: get_irot_handle
function.description: This function checks if the irot_handle is null. If it is, it initializes the protseq and endpoint, gets a new RPC handle, and sets the irot_handle to the new handle if it hasn't been set by another thread. It then returns the irot_handle.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: RPC_BINDING_HANDLE, which represents the handle to the RPC binding.

function.name: rpcss_get_next_seqid
function.description: This function gets the next sequence id for the RPCSS call.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD variable where the next sequence id will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

parameters.name: cookie

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.description: This function is used to note the change in time in the IrotCookie.

parameters.name: cookie
parameters.description: This is the cookie that is used to track the change in time.

parameters.name: time

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. If it failed, it returns an error code.

function.name: InternalIrotGetTimeOfLastChange
function.description: This function is used to get the time of the last change of a moniker.

parameters.name: moniker_data
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the moniker comparison data.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a FILETIME structure that receives the time of the last change.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code.

function.name: InternalIrotEnumRunning
function.description: This function is used to enumerate running interfaces in the Interface Rotator (IRot).

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: A pointer to the list of interfaces to be enumerated.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.description: This function revokes an interface from the running object table (ROT).

parameters.description: This is a unique identifier for the object in the ROT.

parameters.name: ctxt_handle

parameters.name: object

parameters.name: moniker
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the moniker of the object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: rpcss_server_register
function.description: This function registers a server in the RPCSS service.

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: The class identifier of the server to be registered.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags that control the behavior of the function.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: A pointer to the interface of the server.

parameters.name: cookie
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives a value used to identify the server in subsequent calls.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds; otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: rpc_revoke_local_server
function.description: This function revokes the local server using the provided cookie.

parameters.name: cookie
parameters.description: This parameter is used as an identifier to revoke the local server.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: rpcss_get_class_object
function.description: This function is used to get the class object from the RPCSS.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: This is a reference to the class ID.

parameters.name: objref
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface pointer of the object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function call. It can be used to check if the function executed successfully or not.

function.name: start_local_service
function.description: This function starts a local service with the given name and parameters. It opens the service control manager, then opens the service and attempts to start it. If the service is already running, it treats this as a success. It returns an error code indicating the result of the operation.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the service to start.

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: The number of parameters to pass to the service.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: The parameters to pass to the service.

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the error code of the operation. ERROR_SUCCESS if the service was started successfully, otherwise an error code indicating what went wrong.

function.name: create_local_service
function.description: This function attempts to start a local service for a given class ID. It reads the LocalService and ServiceParameters values from the AppID key. If successful, it starts the local service. If unsuccessful, it returns an error.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: This is a reference to the class ID for which the local service is to be started.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. If the function is successful, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: create_server
function.description: This function attempts to create a server for a given class identifier (CLSID). It checks the architecture of the system and opens the registry key for the CLSID. If the key is not found, it tries to open the key for the opposite architecture. If the key is still not found, it returns an error. If the key is found, it queries the default value for the LocalServer32 key. It then starts the EXE server with the -Embedding switch. If the server fails to start, it returns an error. If the server starts successfully, it returns S_OK.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: The class identifier for the server to be created.

parameters.name: process
parameters.description: A pointer to a HANDLE variable that receives the process handle if the server is successfully created.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of server creation. It returns S_OK if the server is successfully created, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: create_surrogate_server
function.description: This function attempts to create a surrogate server for a given class ID (CLSID). It opens the registry keys for the CLSID and the associated AppID, queries for the DllSurrogate value, and then attempts to create a new process running the surrogate server.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: This is a reference to the class ID for which the surrogate server is to be created.

parameters.name: process
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a HANDLE in which the function will store the process handle of the created surrogate server.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: rpc_get_local_class_object
function.description: This function attempts to get a local class object, with a maximum of 30 tries. If unsuccessful, it creates a local service and a server. If still unsuccessful, it returns an error. If successful, it writes the object reference to a stream, unmarshals the local server, queries the service, and releases the local server.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: A reference to the class identifier of the object

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: A reference to the interface identifier

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: A pointer to the object

function.return_type: HRESULT, representing the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, or an error code if the operation fails.

function.name: ChannelHooks_ClientGetSize
function.description: This function calculates the total size of the data that needs to be sent over the wire for all registered channel hooks. It also counts the number of hooks and extensions.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to the channel hook call information

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer data for the channel hook

parameters.name: hook_count
parameters.description: Pointer to the variable that will hold the count of hooks

parameters.name: extension_count
parameters.description: Pointer to the variable that will hold the count of extensions

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the total size of the data that needs to be sent over the wire for all registered channel hooks

function.name: ChannelHooks_ClientFillBuffer
function.description: This function fills a buffer with data from a list of channel hooks. It iterates over each hook, checks if it matches with the data, and if it does, it fills the buffer with the extension size. If the extension size is not zero, it calls the IChannelHook_ClientFillBuffer function to fill the buffer. It also sets the conformance, size, and id of the wire_orpc_extent structure.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to the channel hook call information

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer to be filled

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data to be matched with the channel hooks

parameters.name: hook_count
parameters.description: Number of hooks to be processed

function.return_type: Returns a pointer to the buffer after it has been filled with the channel hook data

function.name: ChannelHooks_ServerNotify
function.description: This function notifies the server about channel hooks. It enters a critical section, iterates over each entry in the channel hooks, checks if the GUIDs are equal, and then calls the IChannelHook_ServerNotify function. It leaves the critical section at the end.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to the channel hook call information

parameters.name: lDataRep
parameters.description: Data representation

parameters.name: first_wire_orpc_extent
parameters.description: Pointer to the first wire ORPC extent

parameters.name: extension_count
parameters.description: Count of extensions

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: ChannelHooks_ServerGetSize
function.description: This function calculates the total size of all extensions in the channel hooks list. It also counts the number of hooks and extensions, and allocates memory for the buffer data.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to the channel hook call information

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer data for the channel hooks

parameters.name: hook_count
parameters.description: Pointer to the variable that will hold the count of hooks

parameters.name: extension_count
parameters.description: Pointer to the variable that will hold the count of extensions

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the total size of all extensions in the channel hooks list

function.name: ChannelHooks_ServerFillBuffer
function.description: This function fills a buffer with data from a list of channel hooks. It iterates over each entry in the channel hooks list, checks if the hook's ID matches with any of the data IDs, and if so, it fills the buffer with the corresponding data. The function also handles critical sections to ensure thread safety.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to the channel hook call information

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer to be filled

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data to be used for filling the buffer

parameters.name: hook_count
parameters.description: Number of hooks to be processed

function.return_type: unsigned char *; Returns the updated buffer after filling it with the data

function.name: ChannelHooks_ClientNotify
function.description: This function notifies the client about the channel hooks. It enters a critical section, iterates over each entry in the channel hooks, checks if the GUIDs are equal, and if not, sets the wire_orpc_extent to NULL. Then it calls the IChannelHook_ClientNotify function with the appropriate parameters. Finally, it leaves the critical section.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to the channel hook call information

parameters.name: lDataRep
parameters.description: Data representation

parameters.name: first_wire_orpc_extent
parameters.description: Pointer to the first wire ORPC extent

parameters.name: extension_count
parameters.description: Count of extensions

parameters.name: hrFault
parameters.description: Handle to the result of the fault

function.return_type: void, does not return anything

function.name: rpc_register_channel_hook
function.description: This function registers a channel hook in a thread-safe manner. It allocates memory for a new channel hook entry, assigns the provided GUID and hook to the new entry, increases the reference count of the hook, and adds the new entry to the tail of the channel hooks list.

parameters.name: rguid
parameters.description: This is the GUID that is assigned to the new channel hook entry.

parameters.name: hook
parameters.description: This is the hook that is assigned to the new channel hook entry and its reference count is increased.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation for the new entry fails, otherwise it returns S_OK.

function.name: rpc_unregister_channel_hooks
function.description: This function unregisters channel hooks. It first enters a critical section, then it iterates over each entry in the channel_hooks list, freeing the memory allocated to each. Finally, it leaves the critical section and deletes it, along with another critical section.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, meaning this function does not return any value.

function.name: RpcChannelBuffer_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches with the ID of IRpcChannelBuffer or IUnknown. If it matches, it increases the reference count of the interface and returns S_OK. If it doesn't match, it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRpcChannelBuffer interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface ID to be checked

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer on success

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface ID matches, E_NOINTERFACE otherwise

function.name: RpcChannelBuffer_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the RpcChannelBuffer object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the RpcChannelBuffer object whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after incrementing.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the RPC channel buffer object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the RPC channel buffer to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after decrement. If the count is zero, the function returns 0 after freeing the buffer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the unmarshaling process. It can be S_OK if the process is successful, or error codes like RPC_E_INVALID_HEADER or RPC_E_VERSION_MISMATCH in case of errors.

function.name: unmarshal_ORPCTHAT

function.name: rpc_execute_call
function.description: This function executes a remote procedure call (RPC). It handles ORPCTHIS and server extensions, manages message state, calls message filter, invokes the method, and manages memory allocation and deallocation.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to a dispatch_params structure that contains information needed for the RPC.

function.return_type: void, meaning it does not return a value

function.name: dispatch_rpc
function.description: This function is used to dispatch an RPC message. It first inquires the object from the RPC message, then gets the dispatch parameters. If the apartment is not multi-threaded, it creates an event and posts a message to the apartment thread. If the apartment is multi-threaded, it executes the RPC call directly. After the call, it releases the resources and raises an exception if the call failed.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: This is the RPC message to be dispatched.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value.

function.name: rpc_register_interface
function.description: This function registers a new interface if it doesn't already exist in the list of registered interfaces. If the interface already exists, it increments the reference count. If the interface doesn't exist, it creates a new one and adds it to the list of registered interfaces.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: This is the reference to the interface identifier that needs to be registered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or the error code returned by RpcServerRegisterIfEx if it fails.

function.name: rpc_unregister_interface
function.description: This function unregisters an interface from the RPC server. It iterates over the list of registered interfaces, and if it finds a match with the provided interface ID, it decreases the reference count. If the reference count reaches zero, it unregisters the interface from the RPC server, removes it from the list, and frees the memory.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: This is the reference to the Interface Identifier that needs to be unregistered.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: This is a boolean value that indicates whether the function should wait until all calls to the interface have completed before returning.

function.return_type: void, which means this function does not return any value.

function.name: rpc_resolve_oxid
function.description: This function is used to resolve an OXID and set the OXID_INFO structure. It currently sets default values and copies the OXID to the IRemUnknown interface's IPID. The function is not yet complete and does not contact the machine's OXID resolver.

parameters.name: oxid
parameters.description: An OXID that needs to be resolved.

parameters.name: oxid_info
parameters.description: A pointer to an OXID_INFO structure that will be set by this function.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the function executes successfully.

function.name: rpc_start_remoting
function.description: This function starts the remoting process in the given apartment if it has not already started. It registers an endpoint for the RPC server to use and starts the apartment's remote unknown.

parameters.name: apt
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the apartment structure where the remoting process will be started.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything
